studio.statement: We are MAVA. An independent web design studio from Helsinki, building websites and online stores that stand out.

approach.p1: MAVA is small by design. Every project is handled directly by the two of us — no account managers, no hand-offs, no layers between you and the people actually building your site.
approach.p2: We adapt to how you like to work. Some clients want weekly check-ins, others want to leave us alone and see the result — either way, we stay flexible and easy to reach throughout the project.
approach.p3: We care about clean, fast, well-built websites — and about being upfront on price and timeline from the first conversation, so there are no surprises along the way.

process.heading: How a project runs
process.intro: Four steps, start to finish — clear, close, and without surprises.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.desc: We start with a conversation — your goals, your customers, and what the site actually needs to do. No forms, no account managers; a direct talk with the people building it.

steps.title: Design
steps.desc: We shape the direction — layout, typography and visual identity — and share it early, so you can react before a single line of code is written.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: We build the site by hand — fast, responsive and carefully finished — keeping you in the loop at whatever pace suits you.

steps.title: Launch
steps.desc: We launch, test everything on real devices, and hand over a site that's genuinely yours to run — and we're still here after go-live.

values.heading: What we stand for
values.intro: The principles behind every project we take on.

items.title: Guaranteed quality
items.desc: Every site we ship is polished, professional and built to a standard we'd proudly put our name on — no cut corners, no 'good enough'.

items.title: Client first
items.desc: Your goals lead every decision. We work closely and directly, and we're not done until you're genuinely happy with the result.

items.title: Fast delivery
items.desc: We move quickly without cutting quality — a working, well-built site in your hands sooner, not months of waiting.

items.title: Flexible pricing
items.desc: Pricing shaped around your project and budget, agreed openly up front — so you always know where you stand.

cta.heading: Let's build something worth showing off.
cta.text: Tell us about your project — we'll take it from there.
